about: Seed data for src/data/events.mjs (visitor brief item 3). Signature events only, each with its official page. Dates are local (America/Indiana/Indianapolis). The descriptions are ours, one plain line each; never copy an organizer's text. The Mill Race Monster Festival has already ended and is included as a test case for hiding past events.

events.name: Mill Race Monster Festival
events.line: A weekend festival built around the 1974 Mill Race Park monster sightings.
events.note: Past event. Keep as a fixture for the past-event test, or drop.

events.name: Deja Vu Art and Fine Craft Show
events.line: A one-day art and fine craft show at The Commons.
events.note: One craft-fair listing site says November 8; the official page says Saturday, November 14, 2026. Use the official page. The ll is The Commons' Chaos I coordinates from Wikipedia.

events.name: Small Business Saturday
events.line: The Saturday after Thanksgiving, a national day for shopping at independent businesses.
events.note: A national observance, not a local event, so there's no venue. Use it to feature the Give local page (visitor brief item 12). Thanksgiving 2026 is November 26.

events.name: Columbus Festival of Lights
events.line: A free downtown holiday celebration with an evening parade.
events.note: The official site says it returns December 5, 2026. The parade time, route and side events are from The Republic's 2025 coverage (parade at 6 p.m. from Fifth and Brown streets) and must be reconfirmed for 2026 before showing them. Produced by Red Arch Community Events.

more_to_research: The official 2027 dates for the events on Visit Columbus Indiana's signature events list: Columbus Farmers Market, Columbus on Tap, Smoke on the Square, Juneteenth Jubilee, Exhibit Columbus (its next cycle begins in 2027), Columbus Pride Festival, Fiesta Latina, Scottish Festival, Hot Rods & Rock 'n' Roll, Mill Race Marathon, Hope Heritage Days, Ethnic Expo
Ask Visit Columbus Indiana for an events feed before adding anything from their calendar
